collision_metric_scope: Protected original math/figures/text ink; the separately verified original prose underline contacts are reported explicitly.

actual_prose_underline_coverage_and_styl.scope: Actual emitted first glyph of every Korean prose word verifies the real PDF shear/font GID and original physical point/baseline. Every emphasized glyph curve is independently read from actual output font programs under actual PDF matrices; source-English prose underline x extents must cover exactly the emitted phrase ink. Native source/math programs and coordinate checks are unchanged.

actual_new_korean_inter_row_ink_audit.method: Exact embedded subset buffers paint glyphs at full-precision positions and angles, original point sizes and baselines; every adjacent row pair plus nonadjacent pairs below1.1em tested at2x threshold220. Cache each row over the union of exact pair clips on the unchanged global pixel grid.
